selected_headlines: St. Lucie County shelter to waive cat adoption fees after taking in 114 cats
source_headlines: St. Lucie County shelter waives adoption fees after taking in 114 cats from alleged hoarding case - WFLX
novel_facts: The Humane Society of St. Lucie County reports taking in 114 cats from the case and facing a capacity crunch
The shelter is partnering with BISSELL Pet Foundation for a two-day emergency adoption event
Adoption fees will be waived for all cats and kittens during the event at 8890 Glades Cut-Off Road
